stories.title: Can the Seahawks 'run it forward' and pull off a rare Super Bowl repeat?
stories.summary: The defending champs are not the favorites to win the Super Bowl or even their division. What hurdles will the Seahawks have in 2026?

stories.title: Drake Maye was awesome in 2025 ... could he be even better in 2026? Why he's ready to roll
stories.summary: The New England quarterback is letting the Super Bowl loss motivate him in 2026.

stories.title: LSU, SEC rift cools as Tigers say issue 'moot' after complying
stories.summary: In what appears to be a deescalation, LSU president Wade Rousse told Greg Sankey that the Tigers have "complied" with SEC rules and that the "issue is moot."

stories.title: Sources: Raiders' Bowers has knee procedure, out 'a game or two'
stories.summary: Raiders star tight end Brock Bowers underwent a meniscus trim Tuesday in Dallas and is expected to miss "a game or two," league sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Alleged victim 'forgives' Antonio Brown, won't take part in prosecution
stories.summary: The alleged victim in Antonio Brown's second-degree attempted murder case said he has decided to "forgive" the former NFL star and "does not wish to participate" in his prosecution.
